subtitle: Textbook for Class VIII
_direction: arc, where Part 1 is comb. Two volumes of one class that share a direction share a palette, and a shelf with both on it would show the same book twice. The back is quoted from _shared/back-arc.html unchanged — the blurb names the class and not the part, so it is genuinely the series' and belongs in _shared. The front and the spine are not: the shared ones set Part 1 in the markup, and a part number is not something cover.json can push into a panel. No finish is declared: on a direction the finish is inert.
_spine: No spineWidth. pages is measured, not guessed: a --book run of class-8 gives this volume 184 numbered pages plus 3 of front matter, which is 187, rounded up to 188 for a multiple of four. At 0.106mm the block bulks to 10.0mm and the case takes it to 10.5, which is what the builder computes and prints — and which is under SLIM_SPINE, so the furniture turns head-to-foot as Part 1's does at 12.8mm. Class 9 overrides its own arithmetic with a printer-quoted 15mm on a stock the caliper here does not describe; get the quote before this goes to press. Re-derive pages from --book whenever a chapter changes length.
